mechanism: Both are bisphosphonates with identical mechanisms of action (osteoclast inhibition), creating redundant pharmacodynamic effects and increased risk of adverse events including osteonecrosis of the jaw, atypical fractures, and severe hypocalcemia.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if sequential bisphosphonate therapy is necessary, allow adequate washout period (minimum 7 days) and monitor for hypocalcemia, renal function, and bone-related adverse events.
